SEMANTIC_KERNEL_SPEC.CLASSIFICATION: SEARCH_ROUTING via bounded generic composition. Frozen primitives alone (A0 == A1; no route key) reach NOTHING -- not even a coerced alias: topological_sort returns [] on the empty set (falsy, but consistent) and None on cycles, so its truthiness is not the target; check_transitivity returns a dict. Verified on all 4,096 four-node digraphs.
